t: The closest a person ever gets to his Lord
a: أَقْرَبُ مَا يَكُونُ الْعَبْدُ مِنْ رَبِّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ وَهُوَ سَاجِدٌ فَأَكْثِرُوا الدُّعَاءَ
p: Aqrabu mā yakūnu-l-ʿabdu min rabbihi ʿazza wa jalla wa huwa sājidun, fa-akthirū-d-duʿāʾ
m: The closest a servant comes to his Lord is while he is prostrating, so make much supplication then.
